question: Why has the transferred RLinf RoboTwin PPO recipe not produced a verified learning gain?
conclusions: Official clean adjust_bottle task-specific pi0.5 PPO success is reported; it was not reproduced by our joint-motor source-task pilot.
Recovered Motus15 optimizer updates reuse one6144-slot collection; no sustained Motus online loop is verified.
Motus4/16->2/16 and earlier Sidney5/16->5/16 endpoint panels show no observed PPO gain.
Collector timeout is an execution failure; long-run convergence and exact original-release reproduction remain unproven.
A sustained source-task PPO control is the next scientific diagnostic; keep frozen-student work as its separately requested arm.
Exact adjust_bottle training conflicts with the current held-out task split; default preserves that split.
